question: Who hosted the United Nation's First International Conference on Digital Public Infrastructure?

options.text: The Permanent Mission of the United States and the Department of Commerce
The Permanent Mission of India and the Ministry of Human Resource Development
The Permanent Mission of India and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, along with iSPIRT
The Permanent Mission of the UK and the Department of Science and Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Permanent Mission of India and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, along with iSPIRT**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The** United Nation's First International Conference on Digital Public Infrastructure** was led by **India**, aiming to utilize technology to advance Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and promote inclusivity, as stated by India's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ruchira Kamboj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The conference, titled **"Digital Public Infrastructure: Citizen Stack,"** was organized by the **Permanent Mission of India** and the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology,** in collaboration with **iSPIRT**, to explore the global implementation of digital public infrastructure.
 
• India's pioneering initiative, Citizen Stack, derived from the successful** India Stack model**, was prominently featured at the conference, showcasing India's integration of technology into citizen services.
 
• The event marked a significant step towards promoting international cooperation for the development of digital infrastructure globally.
 
• Key speakers from the **United Nations System**, including Dennis Francis, President of the United Nations General Assembly, and Achim Steiner, Administrator of the **United Nations Development Programme**, participated in the conference.
 
• **Minister for Railways, Communications, and Electronics & Information Technology **of the Government of India, Ashwini Vaishnav, reiterated India's commitment to sharing the Citizen Stack initiative globally, aligning with the philosophy of **"Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam** - the **world is one family."**
